title: 字母组合迭代器
summary: 按字典序迭代给定有序互异字符中固定长度的所有组合，支持 next 和 hasNext。
insight: 组合总数受约束较小，可在构造时用回溯按选择下标递增顺序生成全部组合；生成顺序天然就是字典序。
pitfalls: 组合内字符保持原字符顺序
每个组合恰好指定长度
next 只在 hasNext 为真时调用

solutions.title: 预生成字典序组合
solutions.idea: 构造阶段回溯生成，查询阶段顺序读取。
steps: 构造保存 combinations 与 index=0，调用 dfs(start,builder)
builder 长度达到 combinationLength 时加入字符串；否则从 start 枚举还能留足字符的下标
next 返回 combinations[index++]；hasNext 判断 index<size

code.java: class CombinationIterator { private final List<String> combinations=new ArrayList<>();private int index=0;private final String characters;private final int length;public CombinationIterator(String characters,int combinationLength){this.characters=characters;this.length=combinationLength;generate(0,new StringBuilder());}private void generate(int start,StringBuilder current){if(current.length()==length){combinations.add(current.toString());return;}for(int i=start;i<=characters.length()-(length-current.length());i++){current.append(characters.charAt(i));generate(i+1,current);current.deleteCharAt(current.length()-1);}}public String next(){return combinations.get(index++);}public boolean hasNext(){return index<combinations.size();} }
code.kotlin: class CombinationIterator(private val characters:String,private val combinationLength:Int) { private val combinations=mutableListOf<String>();private var index=0;init{generate(0,StringBuilder())};private fun generate(start:Int,current:StringBuilder){if(current.length==combinationLength){combinations.add(current.toString());return};for(i in start..characters.length-(combinationLength-current.length)){current.append(characters[i]);generate(i+1,current);current.deleteCharAt(current.lastIndex)}};fun next():String=combinations[index++];fun hasNext():Boolean=index<combinations.size }
code.cpp: class CombinationIterator { vector<string> combinations;int index=0;string characters;int length;void generate(int start,string& current){if((int)current.size()==length){combinations.push_back(current);return;}for(int i=start;i<=(int)characters.size()-(length-current.size());++i){current+=characters[i];generate(i+1,current);current.pop_back();}}public:CombinationIterator(string characters,int combinationLength):characters(characters),length(combinationLength){string current;generate(0,current);}string next(){return combinations[index++];}bool hasNext(){return index<(int)combinations.size();} };
